# Greatest Common Divisor of Strings.

@example "PQ" prints both, but so does "PQPQ" (twice for str1, three times for str2), and nothing longer does.
"PQPQPQPQ"
"PQPQPQPQPQPQ"
=> "PQPQ"

@example Only a one-letter stamp fits strings of 5 and 3 letters.
"KKKKK"
"KKK"
=> "K"

@example A stamp for both has a word whose length divides 6 and 4 and that starts both strings, so only "R" and "RS" could work. "RS" prints str1 but not str2, and "R" prints neither.
"RSRSRS"
"RSRT"
=> ""

# The same string twice: it is its own stamp.
"QWERTY"
"QWERTY"
=> "QWERTY"

# One letter against a run of it that ends in another letter.
"A"
"AAAB"
=> ""

# One letter 6 and 4 times: the longest stamp has two letters, not one.
"BBBBBB"
"BBBB"
=> "BB"

# Three and five copies of the same word.
"TUVTUVTUV"
"TUVTUVTUVTUVTUV"
=> "TUV"

# The same length, differing only in the last letter.
"HIJHIJ"
"HIJHIK"
=> ""

# The same letters in another order.
"NONO"
"ONON"
=> ""

# The 4-letter prefix prints str2, but not str1, whose last letter is off.
"CDCDCDCE"
"CDCD"
=> ""

# The shorter string and the common prefix are both longer than the answer.
"XYXYXYXYXY"
"XYXYXYXY"
=> "XY"

# str1 is str2 and then half of str2 again: str1 + str2 and str2 + str1
# agree on their first 6 letters but not after, and the gcd-length prefix
# "RS" prints neither string.
"RSTURS"
"RSTU"
=> ""

# str2 prints str1, so it is the answer.
"MNOMNOMNOMNO"
"MNOMNO"
=> "MNOMNO"

# Lengths 1000 and 999 of one letter: only the single letter works.
""
""
=> "A"

# Lengths 1000 and 999 of a two-letter pattern: nothing works.
""
""
=> ""

# The longest possible answer: two equal strings of 1000 letters.
""
""
=> ""

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 5 small
"BABABABA"
"BABABAB"
=> ""

@gen 7 small
"BBABBABBB"
"BBABBABBA"
=> ""

@gen 8 small
"BA"
"BABABABABABB"
=> ""

@gen 11 small
"AAAAAAAAAA"
"AAAA"
=> "AA"

@gen 75 small
"BABABABABABA"
"BABABABA"
=> "BABA"

@gen 14 small
"AAB"
"AABAABAABAAB"
=> "AAB"

@gen 248 small
"BBA"
"BBABBABBAB"
=> ""

@gen 20 small
"BBABBABBABBA"
"BABBAB"
=> ""

# Full size: strings of up to 1000 letters.
@gen 1
""
""
=> "WZXWZXWZX"

@gen 23
""
"WWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYYWWXXYY"
=> "WWXXYYWWXXYY"

@gen 24
"CCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBCCCCBC"
""
=> ""
